ios.desc:
Bring your calibre library to your iPhone and iPad. Calibre Companion helps you browse, organize and transfer the books you already own.

CONNECT YOUR LIBRARY
Connect to calibre on your computer over Wi-Fi as a wireless device, browse a calibre Content Server, or access a calibre library stored with a supported cloud provider, including Dropbox, Google Drive and OneDrive.

MAKE YOUR COLLECTION EASY TO EXPLORE
Browse covers or a compact book list. Search as you type, sort your collection, and filter by authors, tags, series and other metadata. View book details and keep track of your reading state.

TAKE YOUR BOOKS WITH YOU
Download books to your device and open them in a compatible reader app. Calibre Companion organizes and transfers books; it is not an ebook reader and does not include books.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
An active subscription removes ads and unlocks Premium. Existing books and the free library remain available without subscribing. An active subscription is required for Premium and ad-free access, including for previous purchasers.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple account. Prices, billing periods and any eligible introductory offer are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple account settings.

Use calibre on your computer to manage your library. Wireless connections require a reachable computer with the corresponding calibre service enabled. Cloud browsing requires your own account and a calibre library stored with the provider.

Calibre Companion is an independent app and is not affiliated with the calibre desktop project.

android.desc:
Keep your calibre library organized on your Android phone or tablet. Browse book covers and details, find your next read, and open books in your preferred reader app.

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• View authors, series, tags, ratings, and other book details.
• Sort, search, and group your collection.
• Switch between cover and list views, with light and night display options.
• Mark books as read and sync reading status with desktop calibre.

CONNECT TO DESKTOP CALIBRE
Connect as a wireless device over Wi-Fi, then use calibre on your computer to send books and update their metadata. You can also browse your calibre Content Server and download books directly to your device.

ACCESS YOUR CLOUD LIBRARY
Browse a complete calibre library stored in Dropbox or Box and download books for use on your device. Cloud libraries must include the metadata.db file and their book folders. A folder containing only ebook files is not a complete calibre library.

OPTIONAL AI PLUS
Ask questions about a book, choose chapters to use as context, and review AI suggestions for its metadata. AI Plus requires Google sign-in, an internet connection and a separate subscription with usage credits. Credit costs are shown before a request. Selected book text and questions are sent to our AI service for processing. AI responses may be inaccurate; review suggestions before applying them. AI Plus and ad removal are separate purchases.

FREE LIBRARY FEATURES, OPTIONAL AD REMOVAL
Library organization and supported connections are available without an ad-removal purchase. The free experience includes banner ads in the library. Choose an optional monthly or annual ad-free subscription, or a one-time purchase for permanent ad removal. Current prices are shown in the app and confirmed by Google Play before purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through Google Play. Canceling stops the next renewal; ad-free access continues until the paid period ends. You can restore eligible ad-removal purchases using the same Google Play account. Previous purchases of the paid app do not automatically enroll you in a subscription or result in new charges. Ad removal is a separate optional purchase.

BEFORE YOU START
Calibre Companion is a library manager, not an ebook reader or file converter. Install a compatible reader app to open your books; supported formats depend on that reader. Books and a desktop calibre library are not included.

quotes.text: I do with Dropbox too, along with a portable version of Calibre.  For syncing to my andoid phone, I use [Calibre Companion](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multipie.calibreandroid).

It's been around for about 17 years and will probably hang around until the author dies.
